entry.title: New: dsh-desk-pet
entry.summary: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies. Exact install spec: deepseek-desk-pet. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
